note: Two modern loops about 1000 ft apart on the west bank of the Missouri River at the Heart River mouth, south of Mandan; the primitive sites line the riprapped riverbank. Two camping cabins and group sites; Custer House and On-A-Slant Village tours in summer. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks confirm $15 primitive (36-55 ft gravel pads, a 23-ft rig fits) / $25 modern ($30 Sat) with 50-amp + water; 97 campsites (66 modern, 15 modern group, 15 primitive, 1 primitive group) with pads 34-86 ft; showers, flush toilets, dump. Groups now manual; note trimmed. Waterfront upgrade candidate (primitive sites 100-114 ~31-46 m from the river over open ground); pin ~290 m off the sites.
flags: WATERFRONT: suggest riverview -> riverfront with a caveat naming the primitive row (stored value is not --AWH; apply.py does not write it). Primitive sites 100-114 ($15, sold nightly on reserveNDparks, gravel pads 36-55 ft) run along the riprapped bank of the Missouri at the Heart River mouth. On Esri imagery (leaf-off) the ground between is mown grass under scattered cottonwoods, a paved trail and the riprap: 104 (46.76775,-100.84358) ~34 m to open water, 108 (46.76817,-100.84388) ~36 m, 111 (46.76852,-100.84412) ~33 m, 113 (46.76876,-100.84428) ~31 m, 114 (46.76886,-100.84436) ~31 m, 100 (46.76721,-100.84332) ~46 m. The river here is several hundred metres wide. The modern loops are 60 m+ back (62-68 ~60-80 m; south loop 01-12 ~80 m through trees). The stored waterfront_evidence measured the modern pads (40-70 m) and missed the primitive row.

PIN: stored 46.76440,-100.84290 lies in the brush between the south loop and the river, ~60 m east of the sites and ~290 m from the centroid of all 97 campsites 46.76679,-100.84443 (on the north loop road). Suggest 46.7668,-100.8444, or keep if the south loop is preferred (stored is ~60 m off it).
